children: Following the September 19, 2026 passing of director Peter A. Bordes, Jr., the company's Audit Committee was reduced to two independent members, causing noncompliance with Nasdaq Rule 5605(c)(2)(A) requiring at least three independent directors. The company notified Nasdaq on September 23, 2026 and will rely on the cure period until the earlier of its next annual meeting or September 19, 2027 to appoint an independent director and regain compliance.
